name: dsfd_be_f16_m5-r1-COMMIT
purpose: Unallocated optional FE sticky-status relay with 16 FF per stage on serial ck. The rn input is a synchronous reset and must receive normal setup/hold input timing, with no reset false path. Default STAGES is zero; six stages is only the FE box distance lower bound, while the unadopted S9 candidate needs a uniform eight stages. Physical source pins, clocks, reset distribution and placement remain open. Data-return latency is unchanged. This standalone physical stress probe uses standard 770ps route/833.333ps signoff constraints, conservatively faster than the requested serial domain; it does not bind any parent clock.
